cards.summary_en: He has repeatedly and recently stated he is very bullish on 688017 as the standout Chinese component leader in humanoid robotics supply chains, citing high barriers in harmonic drives/planetary roller screws, mass low-cost production edge, and material BOM share per unit. He calls it a compelling long-term directional long (not short-term trade) and would personally long it if based in China, even while noting he does not currently hold it.
cards.why_now_en: His thesis centers on forward-looking 3-5 year exponential TAM growth from humanoid mass production and the company's structural dominance in the supply chain, not past performance.
cards.primary_evidence_excerpt: I would personally long LeaderDrive (688017) if I were in China! Still really early on into robotics ramp, but I think they’ll be a clear winner given China’s lead in low cost, mass production robotics.
